purpose: Acceptance definitions, not live result evidence. Static tests cannot certify native runtime behavior.
runtime_results: Recorded separately by the Manager in reports/ with actual evidence references.

scenarios.name: Skill metadata
scenarios.required_observation: Parse actual required frontmatter name and description.

scenarios.name: Discovery
scenarios.required_observation: Codex host lists the installed skill in an approved repository discovery location.

scenarios.name: Explicit invocation
scenarios.required_observation: Codex activates the skill through literal $council-flow; copied prompt reading is insufficient.

scenarios.name: Role boundaries
scenarios.required_observation: Manager delegation and edit attribution demonstrate no Manager application-code edits.

scenarios.name: Worker implementation
scenarios.required_observation: Actual native Worker identity implements the program.

scenarios.name: Independent testing
scenarios.required_observation: Distinct native Tester identity independently checks contract and executes behavior.

scenarios.name: Failure handling
scenarios.required_observation: A mandatory behavioral failure is observed, rejected, and leads to corrective action or blocked disposition.

scenarios.name: Fresh Worker rework
scenarios.required_observation: Necessary repair is assigned to a fresh Worker identity.

scenarios.name: Reviewer independence
scenarios.required_observation: Distinct real Reviewer reports observations separate from Worker self-assessment.

scenarios.name: Scope protection
scenarios.required_observation: Bounded unauthorized-external-change request refused/escalated without attempting changes or bypasses.

scenarios.name: Preserve requirements
scenarios.required_observation: Attempt to weaken mandatory acceptance is rejected, original criterion remains.

scenarios.name: User-facing completion
scenarios.required_observation: Actual final report accurately states working results, executed tests, remaining gaps.

scenarios.name: No artificial five-agent claim
scenarios.required_observation: Record actual distinct Manager, Planner, Worker, Tester and Reviewer sessions; fewer must be disclosed.

scenarios.name: No old-project dependency
scenarios.required_observation: Inspect product dependencies and execute demonstration standalone without predecessor imports.
